caption: The drawing shows a single wooden table with a rectangular top and rounded drop-leaf extensions on each end. The tabletop and the rest of the table are colored in shades of reddish-brown, resembling polished wood grain. The table has a central shallow drawer on the front, which is outlined and features a round, brass-colored handle or decorative knob in the center. The table stands on a single, carved central pedestal which transitions into four curved, splayed legs extending outward. Each leg terminates in a small, brass-colored foot with wheels or casters. The background is a plain, light tan color with some irregular, cloud-like white patches above the left side and below the tabletop, unconnected to the furniture.
title: Pembroke Table
